title: CUMPRINC G6-07: two recon witnesses, and prose stale against the replay
status_plain: The G6-07 catalogue row publishes no count. It rests on two recon witnesses: the full-schedule control matches exactly and the half-schedule witness is 1 ULP off, and from those two rows it localises the evidence to boundary-sensitive accumulation and grades the severity NUM-S. That framing is STALE against a primary artifact the neighbouring G6-01 row cites by path. In the Phase-E production replay CUMPRINC's 45 rows score 10 exact, with 7 rows above 16 ULP and a worst row at 5.27e14 ULP. A one-ULP boundary story and a 5e14-ULP row cannot both describe the same surface, and the prose is the older of the two. This record exists so the contradiction is published rather than smoothed.
